set.body: Join the qualified ICU4X analysis and HarfBuzz/FreeType components in an isolated text probe. Implement script itemization including Common/Inherited and Script_Extensions, explicit supplied-face fallback preserving shaping context, and immutable unwrapped paragraph placement/source mappings shared by measurements and recording. Real multilingual fonts and adversarial context/cluster/closure tests required. No OS discovery, wrapping/carets/core adapter or production GPU host integration claims. Keep one Rust library, pointer-only shims, explicit budgets and ownership, preserve kernel semantics, run JVM and Native checks and record evidence.
set.title: G-0: Itemize scripts, resolve explicit fallback and place unwrapped paragraphs
